name: 01-start-request-monitor
args: async page => { globalThis.dx04Requests = []; page.on('request', req => { const u = new URL(req.url()); globalThis.dx04Requests.push({method:req.method(),origin:u.origin,path:u.pathname}); }); console.log(JSON.stringify({monitor:'method/origin/path only; no headers, bodies, cookies or query'})); }
